format: Explicit Arrow fields serialized as separate Parquet datasets
description: This file is an Arrow contract, not a JSON Schema meta-schema. Implement a strict builder and validators for these fields.

bit_encoding.padding: Unused high bits of the last byte must be zero.
bit_encoding.lengths: syndrome m, correction n, observables k; get dimensions from conditions.

floating_point.hash_bytes: Little-endian IEEE-754 bytes in canonical variable order, preceded by uint64 n.

time_encoding.timestamp: UTC ISO-8601 in manifest; monotonic/process CPU durations are not UTC timestamps

null_policy: Null means unavailable or inapplicable. Counters are zero only when the corresponding instrumented operation did not occur.
file_rules: Create one directory per dataset. Do not flatten grains or use JSON strings for event payloads.
Use explicit Arrow types and field nullability; reject unknown/missing fields before writing.
Every partition file retains key columns with their declared types; readers must not infer contradictory partition types.
Worker-owned bounded typed buffers write batch-sized shards, never one file per shot and never shared append.
Publish a batch inventory only after all of its required dataset shards and hashes are ready.
Analysis reads committed inventory entries, not unfiltered directory globbing.
Empty datasets remain declared with schema and zero rows, without requiring physical empty files.
Resume validates exact model/decoder/build/sampling identities and rejects duplicate or missing keys.
Keep legacy readers and historical output untouched; the new datasets apply to new runs.
Baseline and legacy hybrid profiles get normalized decode_results and available faithful attribution; v2-only candidate/summary rows are not fabricated.
cross_dataset_constraints: Every decode key references shot_inputs and decoder_profiles; every shot references conditions.
For each committed physical batch, each enabled decoder has exactly one result per shot.
Every v2 result has exactly one search_summary and one bp_summary, including early exits/errors.
Missing worker results are not relabeled as successful completed shots; failed batches remain uncommitted/retryable.
Donor update references are same-shot/same-decoder and strictly earlier-cycle references.
sum cycle visits/admissions matches bp_updates/patterns and bp_summary.
First source, final winner source and prefix stop reason must be interpreted separately.
Per-event truth labels are attached after service timing using that event correction, not the final result.
No decoder-side API accepts true observables or per-shot error labels.
Mandatory counters/events are never silently dropped on telemetry-buffer overflow; report an explicit resource error or documented spill behavior outside native timing.

constraints: Physical setup, probability normalization and observable maps are immutable within a condition.
Dimensions and individual histogram counts must fit uint32, or creation must reject this schema version.
sum(column_degree_histogram) == num_fault_variables.

fields.name: osd_entered

fields.name: service_cpu_ns
fields.description: Full adapter decode service including required input/output conversion and verification. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: service_wall_ns
fields.description: Full adapter decode service including required input/output conversion and verification. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: native_cpu_ns
fields.description: Native call span; included within service, not an exclusive additive phase. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: native_wall_ns
fields.description: Native call span; included within service, not an exclusive additive phase. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: prefix_cpu_ns
fields.description: Native pre-OSD span; included within native time, not additive. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: prefix_wall_ns
fields.description: Native pre-OSD span; included within native time, not additive. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: timing_context_id
fields.description: Reference to manifest timing context: clocks, CPU, threads, workers, ordering and profiling.

fields.name: timing_mode
fields.description: Measurement context.

fields.name: profiling
fields.description: Native phase profiling policy.

fields.name: timing_accounting_ok
fields.description: Exclusive phase sum and service/native containment check, null if unmeasured.

constraints: status == valid iff syndrome_valid is true; non-valid outcomes remain countable.
syndrome_valid implies correction, prediction, physical_cost and logical_mismatch are present.
not syndrome_valid implies logical_mismatch and observable_mismatch_packed are null and block_failure is true.
block_failure == ((not syndrome_valid) or logical_mismatch).
Infrastructure exceptions are reported separately by status; never dropped from throughput/failure accounting.
When winner_solution_event_id is non-null, its correction and offline label equal this final result.
Baseline adapters without a returned fault correction must explicitly extend their result API; never fabricate a verification claim.

constraints: expanded_nodes <= max_cycles * expansions_per_cycle.
There is no independent generated-node or total-expansion cap; generated_nodes is bounded indirectly by the finite children of expanded nodes.
Old hybrid/baseline unavailable counters must not be synthesized as zero.

fields.name: bp_prepare_wall_ns

fields.name: bp_iter_cpu_ns
fields.description: Exclusive full BP iteration work, excluding nested solution-validation work. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: bp_iter_wall_ns
fields.description: Exclusive full BP iteration work, excluding nested solution-validation work. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: rank_cpu_ns
fields.description: Exclusive proposal/quota/ranking/controller selection work. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: rank_wall_ns
fields.description: Exclusive proposal/quota/ranking/controller selection work. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

constraints: actual_iterations == sum(bp_updates.actual_iterations).
admissions == number of patterns rows; evaluated_visits == number of bp_updates rows.
cycles_started == number of cycles rows; no per-iteration trace is required.
peak_live_states <= 3 * bp.beam_width for the required implementation, excluding immutable data and scalar work buffers.
Copied lineage iteration counts are provenance only and never counted as work.

beam_after <= configured width; beam_membership represents this reconciled state.

constraints: (decode key,node_id) references patterns; (decode key,cycle_index) references cycles.
An own/ancestor donor_update_id resolves to a usable update from an earlier cycle in this invocation.
An ancestor donor is the nearest strict search ancestor in the frozen entry beam; own is same node.
Cold donor IDs are null and donor_lineage_iterations == 0.
0 <= actual_iterations <= quota; planned quota may be unused after a valid transition.
No row is emitted for a zero-quota or never-started evaluation.
Truth labels are absent from unsuccessful BP states; logical correctness is defined for valid solution events only.

fields.name: bp_update_id
fields.description: BP visit that produced this correction, otherwise null.

fields.name: osd_call_id
fields.description: Fallback call that produced this correction, otherwise null.

fields.name: correction_packed
fields.description: n correction bits, syndrome-valid on the original H/s.

fields.name: predicted_observables_packed
fields.description: k bits A*e; computed without consulting truth.

fields.name: correction_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of n and canonical packed correction.

fields.name: physical_cost
fields.description: Canonical W(e), including every hard-fixed one and independent of BP posterior.

fields.name: fixed_assignment_violations
fields.description: Mismatch against associated BP pattern; null for non-BP sources.

fields.name: incumbent_improved
fields.description: Whether this event installed a lexicographically better incumbent.

fields.name: incumbent_event_id_after
fields.description: Event that owns the incumbent after this discovery.

fields.name: logical_mismatch
fields.description: Offline label from this event correction and shared sampled truth.

fields.name: observable_mismatch_packed
fields.description: Offline k-bit mismatch for this event, not copied from final winner.

fields.name: elapsed_cpu_ns
fields.description: Optional service-start-to-discovery cumulative span; never an additive phase. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: elapsed_wall_ns
fields.description: Optional service-start-to-discovery cumulative span; never an additive phase. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

constraints: Each event is independently verified and independently truth-annotated outside the decode service timer.
Do not copy the final winner label onto earlier solution events.
Duplicate discoveries remain rows; equal incumbent keys do not replace the earlier event.
No solution events are emitted for nonconvergent or invalid hard decisions.
The zero-syndrome shortcut emits one event for e=0 without constructing a search root.

osd_calls.grain: One row per actual direct OSD fallback call; at most one per v2 invocation.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Unique UTC-timestamped run identity; never reused for incompatible provenance.

fields.name: condition_id
fields.description: Hash of the physical condition and prepared model identity.

fields.name: shot_id
fields.description: Zero-based physical shot ordinal within this condition, independent of worker completion order.

fields.name: decoder_id
fields.description: Hash of the fully resolved decoder algorithm/configuration and native build identity.

fields.name: osd_call_id
fields.description: Zero for the only permitted call.

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: Prefix stopping reason that led to fallback.

fields.name: llr_policy
fields.description: Configured handoff policy.

fields.name: llr_actual_source
fields.description: Actual LLR vector supplied.

fields.name: source_node_id
fields.description: Selected retained candidate, if any.

fields.name: source_update_id
fields.description: Usable update underlying the selected state.

fields.name: llr_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of canonical signed binary64 LLR bytes and n.

fields.name: osd_method
fields.description: Pinned direct OSD method.

fields.name: osd_order
fields.description: Must equal zero.

fields.name: ordering
fields.description: Preserved pinned upstream ordering.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Normalized fallback status.

fields.name: syndrome_valid
fields.description: Verified original-H/s validity of fallback output.

fields.name: solution_event_id
fields.description: Matching validated fallback solution event.

fields.name: logical_mismatch
fields.description: Offline label if valid; null otherwise.

fields.name: osd_cpu_ns
fields.description: Exclusive OSD invocation/bridge work; excludes separately timed solution validation. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: osd_wall_ns
fields.description: Exclusive OSD invocation/bridge work; excludes separately timed solution validation. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

constraints: No call is made when a prefix incumbent exists.
The source candidate minimizes the configured K_B over final retained usable candidates.
A missing retained state forces physical channel LLRs; channel_only always uses channel.
Fixed variables are restored in the full-vector handoff and all OSD output is checked against original H/s.
No public wrapper may execute a hidden BP pass.
OSD work is outside the prefix CPU cap.

phase_timings.grain: One exclusive aggregate per phase/context in an invocation.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Unique UTC-timestamped run identity; never reused for incompatible provenance.

fields.name: condition_id
fields.description: Hash of the physical condition and prepared model identity.

fields.name: shot_id
fields.description: Zero-based physical shot ordinal within this condition, independent of worker completion order.

fields.name: decoder_id
fields.description: Hash of the fully resolved decoder algorithm/configuration and native build identity.

fields.name: phase_row_id
fields.description: Contiguous aggregate-row index after deterministic phase/context sorting.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Exclusive service-time component.

fields.name: cycle_index
fields.description: Associated cycle, or null for invocation-level work.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: Associated candidate when applicable.

fields.name: scope_count
fields.description: Number of disjoint native or adapter scopes aggregated into this row.

fields.name: exclusive_cpu_ns
fields.description: Nonoverlapping work assigned to this phase/context. Process CPU time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

fields.name: exclusive_wall_ns
fields.description: Nonoverlapping work assigned to this phase/context. Monotonic wall time. Unit: nanoseconds; nonnegative when present.

constraints: Only emitted when profiling == phases.
Sum exclusive CPU/wall across rows equals service CPU/wall, including adapter remainder in other.
Do not emit inclusive parent timers as additive phase rows.
Native/prefix/cycle/discovery spans are separate descriptive columns, not phase rows.
A negative residual remainder is an accounting error, not clamped silently to zero.

search_nodes.grain: Optional debug trace: one row per constructed node, including root and rejected nodes.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Unique UTC-timestamped run identity; never reused for incompatible provenance.

fields.name: condition_id
fields.description: Hash of the physical condition and prepared model identity.

fields.name: shot_id
fields.description: Zero-based physical shot ordinal within this condition, independent of worker completion order.

fields.name: decoder_id
fields.description: Hash of the fully resolved decoder algorithm/configuration and native build identity.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: Contiguous construction ID; root is zero.

fields.name: parent_node_id
fields.description: Search parent; null for root.

fields.name: generated_cycle
fields.description: Construction cycle; null for root outside cycles.

fields.name: selected_one_index
fields.description: One-bit chosen by this child; null for root.

fields.name: added_zero_indices
fields.description: Canonical child zero-prefix, sorted by fault index for storage.

fields.name: ones_depth
fields.description: Constructed node depth.

fields.name: search_residual_weight
fields.description: rho_v, never the BP residual.

fields.name: g
fields.description: Physical cost g_v.

fields.name: h
fields.description: Heuristic; null only for a locally infeasible node.

fields.name: f
fields.description: g+h; null only for a locally infeasible node.

fields.name: construction_status
fields.description: Status immediately after construction.

fields.name: search_final_status
fields.description: Final independent Q lifecycle.

fields.name: bp_admitted
fields.description: Whether this node was separately admitted to BP.

constraints: Disabled by default; if enabled, generated_nodes equals this row count.
h/f are null for infeasibility, not Infinity or NaN.
This debug dataset must not be required for ordinary analysis or foreign-key validity.
